Leaning toward AWESOME for this Higgsfield shot, since the owner asked for cmux explicitly and most of their Higgsfield shots have landed well. The garbled text in the panes could still bother them, though, and the skewed perspective is the same kind of issue that got an earlier shot sent back for an edit.
